# SECflow

Zero-cost security scanning for AI-driven repos — secrets (gitleaks), dep vulns (trivy/npm audit), custom regex rules, AI-ready fix reports.

Install: `npm i -g secflow` (or `pnpm add -g secflow`, or `npx secflow@latest`). Requires Node 18+. gitleaks binary recommended for real secret coverage (`brew install gitleaks`).

## Core
- [README.md](README.md) — overview, install (npm/pnpm/npx), usage, GitHub Action, config
- [llms.txt](llms.txt) — LLM-facing brief (this file)
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt) — extended brief: commands, flags, report contract
- [LICENSE](LICENSE) — MIT

## Code
- [bin/secflow.js](bin/secflow.js) — the entire CLI (single file, zero deps, Node 18+)
- [action/action.yml](action/action.yml) — composite GitHub Action (`uses: imsankz/secflow@main`)
- [examples/security.yml](examples/security.yml) — example consumer workflow
- [tests/run.js](tests/run.js) — smoke tests (8 tests, plain node asserts, `npm test`)
- [secflow.yml](secflow.yml) — self-config (excludes tests/ from self-scan)

## CI
- [.github/workflows/security.yml](.github/workflows/security.yml) — self-scan workflow (test suite + gitleaks gate + full scan)

## Config
- [.gitleaks.toml](.gitleaks.toml) — allowlist for test fixtures (regex-based only)
- [.gitignore](.gitignore) — node_modules/, .secflow/, *.log

## Conventions for agents
- Test fixtures use invalid `REPLACEME` tokens — never real-looking fake secrets (GitHub push protection blocks them).
- Verify before done: `npm test` (8/8) + `node bin/secflow.js scan --skip trivy` (0 findings).
